Meet our shopper · an illustrative character

Riya, 27. Shopping for a Diwali gift for her sister, and a little something for herself.

She found Swashaa on Instagram. She likes pieces she can wear every day, buys on her phone in the evening, and notices a good offer. Swashaa's own "Buy 3 or more, get flat 50% off" makes her want three pieces, not one. She needs them in time for the gift. Everything below happens to her.

Everyday jewelleryShops on mobileNeeds it in time for DiwaliFirst order with Swashaa
The idea in one picture

Same shopper, same offer. The difference is what the checkout knows about the parcel.

Swashaa's own offers are strong: 50% off when she buys three, 10% extra on prepaid, free shipping and COD. The question is how many Riyas reach the order, pay upfront and keep the parcel. Here is where each path can slip, and where it holds.
Riya on the checkout Swashaa uses today · from Swashaa's pages and GoKwik's public listing

A capable checkout. But it works from payment-side data, and Riya never sees when her gift will arrive until after she has decided.

The difference in one line

"A suite built on payment data can tell you a transaction succeeded. Only one built on top of an actual delivery network can tell you, before the order ships, whether it is coming back."

What We Have Built Recently

fastrr is a bigger product than the checkout you first saw.

Here is what is now live across the fastrr suite. Each one appears in Riya's journey below, at the exact step where it matters.

Before the click

Ads & Studio, Signals, Identify

Creative insight and bulk launch, 100+ audience signals from real purchase behaviour, and recognition of up to 40% of anonymous visitors.

On the page

Dynamic EDD, SDD / NDD, PDP discount widget

A delivery date for her pincode, same-day and next-day where they apply, and the best offer shown beside Add to Cart.

On the page

Assist, the AI sales manager

Answers questions in about 3 seconds, 24x7, guides her to a product and adds to cart in the chat.

In the cart

Milestone bar, expandable AI upsell

Progress toward your next offer tier, with a matching add-on that opens inside the cart.

At checkout

SSO, Quick Pay, smart gateway switching

One-tap login and payment for returning shoppers, and real-time routing to the best-performing gateway.

Payments and risk

Pay After Delivery, RTO Suite, rule engine

A safe option for hesitant COD shoppers, pre-shipment confirmation for risky orders, and rules you can A/B test.

After the order

Connect: WhatsApp, SMS, email, AI Calling

Journeys from abandoned cart to reorder, with a dedicated strategy manager who plans them with your team.

Riya's Journey, Side By Side

At each step: what she gets on GoKwik, and what she gets on fastrr.

The GoKwik column is based on Swashaa's live pages and GoKwik's public Shopify listing, so it may not show everything in its enterprise product. The fastrr column is what is live today.

1 · Discover
Riya sees an ad for a pair of earrings a week before Diwali. She taps, browses a few pieces, and leaves without logging in.
Live on GoKwik
  • She is anonymous until she creates a cart.
  • Cart recovery and WhatsApp order messages begin once she has a cart.
  • Ad targeting depends on the signals Meta receives.
Live on fastrr
  • Signals: 100+ audience signals from real purchase behaviour, so ads find buyers who keep their orders.
  • Identify: up to 40% of anonymous visitors recognised, so she is reachable even if she left.
  • Connect: a WhatsApp reminder for the exact piece she viewed.
5.9x vs 1.05x ROAS in a fastrr example, same budget, only the hook and CTA changed. 20x ROAS on re-engaged anonymous shoppers.
2 · The product page
She likes a pair of earrings. Before she adds it she wonders: will it reach in time for the gift, and which offer is best?
Live on GoKwik
  • Swashaa's offers are on the page: Buy 3 or more for flat 50% off, and 10% extra on prepaid.
  • On the pages we reviewed there is no delivery date or pincode check.
  • GoKwik's listing does not describe a delivery date widget.
Live on fastrr
  • Dynamic EDD: a date for her pincode, pre-filled, 96%+ accurate, from the network that ships the order.
  • SDD / NDD where they apply, for last-minute gifts.
  • PDP discount widget: the 50% tier and the prepaid saving beside Add to Cart.
  • Assist: answers "is this nickel-free?" in about 3 seconds.
12–22% product-page-to-cart lift on brands that show EDD on the page.
Dynamic EDD — pincode pre-filled, delivery date on the product page
3 · The cart
She adds one pair. To get 50% off she needs two more.
Live on GoKwik
  • Cross-sell, one-click and post-purchase upsells are listed.
  • Offers apply per Swashaa's rules.
Live on fastrr
  • Milestone bar: "Add 2 more to unlock flat 50% off", always in sight.
  • Expandable AI upsell: a matching necklace or earring opens inside the cart, variants selectable, added in one tap.
  • Best offer applied automatically, no code to hunt for.
Swashaa's own 3-piece offer is the lever. The cart makes it visible and does the suggesting. No new discount is needed.
Milestone bar — live on Parul Garg Beauty
Expandable AI upsell
4 · The checkout
She taps Checkout with three pieces in her cart. This is where typing an address on a phone costs you shoppers.
Live on GoKwik
  • Smart login and address prefill and validation are listed.
  • An accuracy figure for prefill is not published on the listing.
Live on fastrr
  • Address pre-fill from addresses actually delivered across 400M+ consumers, 98% accuracy.
  • EDD again at checkout, so the promise she saw on the page holds.
  • SSO and Quick Pay: returning shoppers skip OTPs and pick their preferred UPI app in one tap.
17% higher conversion on Rare Rabbit after moving to the fastrr checkout. 65% SSO acceleration.
fastrr Checkout — live on Innovist, with address pre-fill, EDD and Quick Pay
5 · How she pays
Swashaa gives 10% extra on prepaid and offers COD with free shipping. A higher-value jewellery basket makes a returned COD parcel costly.
Live on GoKwik
  • COD blocking with 70+ interventions, and prepaid incentives, are listed.
  • Pay After Delivery and gateway switching are not described on the listing.
Live on fastrr
  • RTO risk tagging from 620M+ real delivery outcomes, before the order ships.
  • Pay After Delivery: hesitant or high-risk shoppers approve with UPI, and are charged only after delivery.
  • Custom rule engine: your own rules, A/B tested.
  • Smart gateway switching to keep payments from failing in sale hours.
Up to 30% RTO reduction with risk tagging. 80% → 92% prepaid on Fixderma. Payment abandonment 28% → 19%.
Pay After Delivery
Risk tags
6 · After the order
Her order ships. Later, she may reorder for herself or buy for the next occasion.
Live on GoKwik
  • Free WhatsApp order notifications and cart recovery are listed.
Live on fastrr
  • RTO Suite: confirmation and address verification on risky COD orders before dispatch.
  • Connect: WhatsApp, SMS, email and AI Calling on abandoned carts.
  • Gifting journeys: a reminder ahead of the next festive moment, planned with your strategy manager.
24% → 14% RTO in 45 days for a fashion brand using pre-shipment confirmation.
